name: agent-companion
description: Guardrails and calibration for agent teams: keeps the main thread delegating, caps premium-model fan-out, watches instruction budget, and detects harness drift.

delegation_guard.title: Delegation guard
delegation_guard.description: Nudge the MAIN thread to delegate after repeated execution-class tool calls. Never applies inside subagents.

delegation_threshold.title: Delegation threshold
delegation_threshold.description: Consecutive main-thread execution calls tolerated before the guard fires.

premium_cap.title: Premium fan-out cap
premium_cap.description: Limit how many premium-tier (fable/opus) subagents may run concurrently.

premium_max_concurrent.title: Max concurrent premium agents
premium_max_concurrent.description: How many premium-tier subagents may run at once before further spawns are denied.

warrant_required.title: Premium warrant
warrant_required.description: Require a stated justification when spawning a premium-tier subagent.

memory_budget.title: Memory budget monitor
memory_budget.description: Warn when always-loaded instruction files get too large, and write a refactor prompt.

memory_budget_tokens.title: Memory budget (tokens)
memory_budget_tokens.description: Token ceiling for a single always-loaded instruction file before it is flagged.

spawn_telemetry.title: Spawn telemetry
spawn_telemetry.description: Record every subagent spawn (model, type, agent_type) for the calibration routine.

memory_doctor.title: Memory doctor
memory_doctor.description: Detect unreachable memory files (on disk but absent from the index) and broken index links. Repair is non-destructive and opt-in via --fix.

memory_archive_prefixes.title: Historical memory prefixes
memory_archive_prefixes.description: Comma-separated filename prefixes treated as historical and safe to archive. Anything else is treated as a live rule and re-linked instead.

telemetry_endpoint.title: Telemetry endpoint
telemetry_endpoint.description: Optional. Full URL to POST emitted telemetry to at session end. EMPTY BY DEFAULT — while empty the plugin makes no network calls at all. Setting it is the only thing that turns sending on.

telemetry_tenant.title: Telemetry tenant
telemetry_tenant.description: Tenant key sent with uploads when a telemetry endpoint is configured.

telemetry_interval_cloud_min.title: Cloud send interval (minutes)
telemetry_interval_cloud_min.description: How often a cloud session ships telemetry at turn boundaries. Cloud filesystems vanish with the session and there is no later sweep, so this is shorter than the local interval.

telemetry_interval_local_min.title: Local send interval (minutes)
telemetry_interval_local_min.description: How often a local session ships telemetry at turn boundaries. Local runs are backstopped by the on-disk JSONL, so this can be relaxed.

scout_surface.title: Scout surface
scout_surface.description: At session start, surface unresolved signals from the last locally scheduled scout run. Silent when the scout found nothing.

fit_guard.title: Best-fit guard
fit_guard.description: When a spawn brief declares WEIGHT (and optionally KIND / CONSEQUENCE), grade the named model against the routing table: under- and cheap-over-provisioned spawns are allowed and announced; a premium model over-provisioned for its own declared weight is denied with the correction. Off = telemetry only.

fit_autofill.title: Best-fit autofill
fit_autofill.description: When a spawn declares WEIGHT but names no model, set the model from the routing table instead of letting it inherit the lead’s tier. Premium results still require a WARRANT line.

update_notice.title: Update notice
update_notice.description: At session start, say when a newer plugin version is installed but this session is still running an older one. No side effects; updating itself is left to the harness and the daily local scout.

memory_search.title: Memory search
memory_search.description: Master switch for BM25 retrieval over the operator's memory corpus. Gates the spawn-time memory brief below (memory_brief also has to be on). Does not gate scripts/memory-search.mjs itself — like memory-doctor.mjs, that CLI runs whenever invoked directly; this only controls automatic use from a hook. Read-only with respect to memory files; the index it builds is derived and disposable.

memory_brief.title: Memory brief at spawn
memory_brief.description: Append at most memory_brief_max_hits relevant memory pointers to a subagent's brief when the spawn declares a prompt and the top BM25 hit clears memory_brief_min_score. Silent otherwise — most spawns get nothing appended. Requires memory_search to also be on (it is the master switch).

memory_brief_max_hits.title: Memory brief max hits
memory_brief_max_hits.description: How many memory pointers to append to a spawn brief at most.

memory_brief_min_score.title: Memory brief minimum score
memory_brief_min_score.description: Raw BM25 score (k1=1.2, b=0.75, summed over matched query terms) the top hit must clear before any pointer block is appended. Below this the brief is left untouched. Calibrated against this operator's real corpus (~435 files / 1400 chunks): realistic-length spawn briefs on a genuinely relevant topic scored 27-51 here, but same-length off-topic briefs scored up to 30 purely from a few incidentally rare shared words — there is no score that cleanly separates the two on this corpus, longer briefs simply accumulate more incidental overlap. 25 is set to favor silence: it costs some true positives (an on-topic but lower-scoring brief gets nothing) to keep the false-positive rate low, matching "silence is the default state."
